title: CRM and Lifecycle Manager II
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 We're hiring a CRM & Lifecycle Manager II to join the Growth Marketing team within Marketing and lead how Coinbase engages and retains millions of users through lifecycle campaigns at global scale. This team owns CRM strategy and execution across email, push, in-app, and SMS, turning user data into personalized journeys that drive onboarding, engagement, and retention. You'll define lifecycle strategies for high-impact user segments, lead cross-functional campaign initiatives across multiple countries, and set the standard for how the team measures and optimizes CRM performance.
 What you'll do:
 Own lifecycle strategy for key user journeys, including onboarding, engagement, and retention, defining segmentation, channel mix, and targeting approaches that drive measurable growth.
 Lead end-to-end planning and execution of multi-channel CRM campaigns (email, push, in-app, SMS) across multiple countries, balancing speed with quality at scale.
 Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, and regional stakeholders to align CRM initiatives with product launches, growth priorities, and international expansion goals.
 Drive the CRM measurement framework by defining KPIs, building reporting cadences, and translating campaign performance data into strategic recommendations for leadership.
 Identify gaps in existing customer journeys and design actionable plans to close them,…

title: Compliance Manager, Card
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team
 The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.
 About the role
 Affirm is seeking a Compliance Manager to own compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program. You'll make independent, risk-based calls across card marketing, onboarding, disputes, and remediation, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations to ship card features that are compliant and built to last.
 What you'll do
 Own end-to-end compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program, including card marketing, checkout, onboarding, wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), disputes, and servicing, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Operations throughout the development lifecycle
 Bring an appetite for the unknown: much of what we build on Card is genuinely new and without precedent, and you take on that ambiguity rather than wait for a playbook
 Apply sound judgment under EFTA (Reg E), TILA (Reg Z)/CARD Act, UDAAP, to navigate novel regulatory questions, escalating only where it's genuinely warranted
 Review and approve Affirm Card marketing, disclosures, and UX to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and consistency with consumer protection standards
 Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for Card compliance issues (e.g., disputes, adverse action notices, declines) through to sustainable closure, prioritizing durable fixes over one-off p…

title: Working Student Deposit Operations (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Synchronised Model Deposit Operations Team is a specialized unit within the Operations Department responsible for the technical and operational management of real-time deposit flows for partners using Portal, Hybrid, and Automation integration models. In these models, the Deposit-taking Bank (DtB) remains the source of truth for the deposit ledger, and the team ensures Raisin’s systems stay aligned with the bank's records.


Your Responsibilities

  • Payment & Sync Governance: Execute and supervise real-time automated payment flows. Perform manual interventions and corrective postings under the Four-Eyes Principle to resolve synchronization lags and ensure transaction finality.
